title: 3D NAND Inspection - Haze Detection on Surfscan SP7
subtitle: Post-Implant Quality Validation for 3nm Node Manufacturing
author: Dr. Yuki Tanaka

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the Surfscan SP7 system to detect and classify Haze defects during post-implant inspection at the 3nm technology node. The test is conducted at Singapore Fab 7 to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 450mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for Haze defects that are critical to yield at the 3nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the Surfscan SP7 platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: Surfscan SP7
- Inspection Type: 3D NAND Inspection
- Target Defect: Haze
- Process Step: Post-Implant
- Wafer Size: 450mm
- Technology Node: 3nm
- Fab Location: Singapore Fab 7

This test case applies to all Surfscan SP7 systems deployed at Singapore Fab 7 for post-implant monitoring in the 3nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: Surfscan SP7
Software Version: v15.6.827
Recipe: 3D_NAND_INSPECTION_3nm_POST_IMPLANT
Illumination Mode: Darkfield
Scan Speed: High (135 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 0.25μm
Edge Exclusion: 3mm
Sampling Plan: 5-point sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the Surfscan SP7 system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the '3D NAND Inspection' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target Haze defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 3nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 93 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 99% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±0.6% for 3D NAND Inspection
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.98 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2024-11-27
Wafers Tested: 46
Total Defects Found: 2541
Defect Density: 808.83 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 3.4%
Capture Rate: 91.2%
Test Duration: 71 minutes
System Uptime: 96.0%

Result Classification: CONDITIONAL PASS
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The Surfscan SP7 demonstrated acceptable performance in detecting Haze at the 3nm node.

b) The capture rate exceeded the minimum threshold, confirming system readiness.

c) Nuisance rate is within acceptable limits.

d) Throughput metrics met production requirements without sensitivity compromise.

e) Statistical process control charts showed stable performance over the test period.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
The following corrective actions are recommended:

1. Review edge-zone detection parameters for optimization.
2. Schedule follow-up test after recipe optimization.
3. Monitor performance over next 30 production days.
